rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Human souls chase desire, overlook their welfare, and resist the remedy because they fixate on worldly adornment.
rows.anchor: النفوس نزاعة إلى الهوى , عمية عن المصالح , جامحة عن الدواء بما وقفت عنده من النظر إلى زينة الحياة الدنيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The proof that the People of Scripture lack reason applies to the Arabs even more strongly.
rows.anchor: وكان الدليل على سلب العقل عن أهل الكتاب دليلا على العرب بطريق الأولى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because the People of Scripture are learned and stubborn in debate, only the most sincere servants can adequately contend with them.
rows.anchor: وكان أهل الكتاب لكونهم أهل علم لا ينهض بمحاجتهم إلا الأفراد من خلص العباد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God directs the greatest of creation to rebuke and shame them, exposing their irrationality.
rows.anchor: آمرا لأعظم خلقه بتبكيتهم وتوبيخهم وتقريعهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The address People of Scripture refers to Jews and Christians.
rows.anchor: ياأهل الكتاب } أي من اليهود والنصارى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verb تنقمون means that they reject, dislike, and find fault with something.
rows.anchor: هل تنقمون } أي تنكرون وتكرهون وتعيبون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their sole complaint against the believers is that they believe in God and what He revealed.
rows.anchor: إلا أن آمنا } أي أوجدنا الإيمان { بالله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The revelation to the Muslims is inimitable across its expansive, intermediate, and concise forms.
rows.anchor: وما أنزل إلينا } أي لما له من الإعجاز في حالات الإطناب والتوسط والإيجاز

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase from before includes earlier revelation because the sending of scriptures did not exhaust all past time.
rows.anchor: من قبل } أي لما شهد له كتابنا , وهذه الأشياء التي آمنا بها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The things believers affirm are unmistakably true and have evidence clearer than the sun.
rows.anchor: وهذه الأشياء التي آمنا بها لا يحيد فيها عاقل , لما لها من الأدلة التي وضوحها يفوق الشمس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The qualifier most of you leaves room for some among the People of Scripture to believe; most are deeply sinful.
rows.anchor: وأن } أي آمنا كلنا مع أن أو والحال أن { أكثركم } قيد به إخراجا لمن يؤمن منهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fāsiqūn describes people deeply estranged from felicity, with no return to accepted worship.
rows.anchor: عريقون في الفسق , وهو الخروج عن دار السعادة بحيث لا يمكن منهم رجوع إلى المرضى من العبادة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They resent the believers only for their difference: Muslims believe in God and His commands while the People of Scripture reject them despite knowing their scripture.
rows.anchor: فبين أنهم لا ينقمون من المؤمنين إلا المخالفة , والمخالفة إنما هي بإيمان المسلمين بالله وما أمر به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their own scripture teaches that God supports believers and abandons disbelievers to destruction and lasting punishment.
rows.anchor: مع علمهم بما تقدم لهم أن من آمن بالله كان الله معه , فنصره على كل من يناويه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: No one is more astray or less rational than someone who knowingly chooses what leads to ruin.
rows.anchor: ومن ركب ما يؤديه إلى ذلك على علم منه واختيار لم يكن أصلا أحد أضل منه ولا أعدم عقلا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They mock believers and shun opponents without considering that an apparent dislike may be a cure and a loved thing may bring harm.
rows.anchor: بكونهم ينسبونهم إلى الشر بجعلهم إياهم موضع الهزء واللعب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The disliked thing may lead to healing, while what is loved may lead to ruin.
rows.anchor: والمكروه قد يؤول إلى الشفاء , والمحبوب يجر إلى العطب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The believers whom they ridicule occupy a lofty rank compared with the People of Scripture's condition.
rows.anchor: بين لهم أن تلك رتبة سنية ومنزلة علية بالنسبة إلى ما هم فيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Messenger alone can meet their learning and obstinacy, aided by the knowledge revealed to him.
rows.anchor: لا ينهض بمحاجتهم لعلمهم ولددهم غيره لما جبلت عليه من قوة الفهم ثم لما أنزل عليك من العلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The singular address signals their blind hearts and that only one supported by God's spirit fully grasps the comparison.
rows.anchor: ووحد حرف الخطاب إشارة إلى عمى قلوبهم وأن هذه المقايسة لا يفهمها حق الفهم إلا المؤيد بروح من الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: هل أنبئكم promises a sure, weighty, and momentous report.
rows.anchor: هل أنبئكم } أي أخبركم إخبارا متقنا معظما جليلا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The comparison concerns a fate worse than the supposedly blameworthy faith they resent.
rows.anchor: بشر من ذلك } أي الأمر الذي نقمتموه علينا مع كونه قيما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Thawāb normally denotes a good reward, just as punishment denotes an evil recompense, making its use here ironic.
rows.anchor: المثوبة للخير كما أن العقوبة للشر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mathūbah is a mimetic verbal noun, like al-maysūr and al-maʿqūl.
rows.anchor: وهي مصدر ميمي كالميسور والمعقول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Calling the recompense one from God first honors its source before the passage turns to its ironic meaning.
rows.anchor: ثم نوه بشرفه بقوله : { عند الله } أي المحيط بصفات الجلال والإكرام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The promise of a better recompense is sarcastic, like greeting someone with a painful blow.
rows.anchor: بيانا لأنه استعارة تهكمية على طريق : تحية بينهم ضرب وجيع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's curse means that He has distanced and expelled the person, and His anger means that He destroyed him.
rows.anchor: لعنة الله } أي أبعده الملك الأعظم وطرده { وغضب عليه } أي أهلكه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The transformation into apes and pigs is a tangible sign of the curse and anger, and the plural marks many accursed people.
rows.anchor: ودل على اللعن والغضب بأمر محسوس فقال : { وجعل } ودل على كثرة الملعونين بجمع الضمير

rows.speaker: ابن قتيبة
rows.claim: Ibn Qutayba says the generic definite article suggests the transformed people did not die out but reproduced into the recognizable species.
rows.anchor: والتعريف للجنس , وقال ابن قتيبة :

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On the majority reading, worship of the false deity is joined to the clause about God's curse, placing the consequence before its causes for emphasis.
rows.anchor: ثم عطف - على قراءة الجماعة - على قوله { لعنه الله } سبب ذلك بعد أن قدم المسبب اهتماما به

rows.speaker: حمزة
rows.claim: Hamza reads عَبُدَ with a damma on bāʾ as a plural, conjoined to القردة.
rows.anchor: وقرأه حمزة بضم الباء على أنه جمع والإضافة عطف على القردة

rows.speaker: القاموس
rows.claim: The lexicon gives ṭāghūt a broad range: idols, soothsayers, Satan, leaders of misguidance, and anything worshipped besides God.
rows.anchor: فهو - كما قال في القاموس - اللات والعزى والكاهن والشيطان وكل رأس ضلال والأصنام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They embellished other religions out of envy for Islam and worshipped idols even in Moses's era; through magic, their star worship made them resemble the Sabians.
rows.anchor: أما اللات والعزى وغيرهما مما لم يعبدوه صريحا فلتحسينهم دين أهله حسدا للإسلامن وقد عبدوا الأوثان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author grants their accusation for argument's sake, then contrasts it with the believers' lack of any curse, anger, animal transformation, or worship of others.
rows.anchor: لم يأت كتاب بلعننا ولا بالغضب علينا ولا مسخنا قردة ولا خنازير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Since the People of Scripture experienced all these things, they are plainly worse and more astray; a rational person chooses the lesser evil.
rows.anchor: وأنتم قد وقع بكم جميع ذلك , لا تقدرون أن تتبرؤوا من شيء منه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The distant demonstrative refers to those characterized by the curse, while worse in place is a metonym for deeply rooted wickedness.
rows.anchor: أي البعداء البغضاء الموصوفون باللعن وما معه { شر مكانا } وإذا كان ذلك لمكانهم فما ظنك بأنفسهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He is more astray than those they accuse, with the author conceding their charge rhetorically to make the case fully.
rows.anchor: وسلم لهم ذلك فيهم إرخاء للعنان قصدا للإبلاغ في البيان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sawāʾ al-sabīl means the road's straight and equitable course.
rows.anchor: عن سواء } أي قصد وعدل { السبيل * } أي الطريق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the demonstrative points back to the first proof of their irrationality, so the passage need not be read as a concession.
rows.anchor: ويجوز أن تكون الإشارة في ذلكإلى ما دل عليه الدليل الأول من عدم عقلهم ولا تنزل حينئذ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Torah they possess, in its fifth book, itself testifies to the curses attached to idolatry and covenant violations.
rows.anchor: في نص التوراة التي بين أظهرهم في السفر الخامس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The cited Torah passage curses image-making, harming neighbors, misleading the blind, injustice to the vulnerable, and failure to uphold the Torah covenant.
rows.anchor: ملعونا يكون الذي يتخذ أصناما مسبوكة وأوثانا منحوتة أمام الرب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Torah threatens punishment and a broad national curse for disobeying God's commands, including defeat and devastation by other peoples.
rows.anchor: ينزل بكم هذا اللعن الذي أقص عليكم كله ويدرككم العقاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The quoted covenant curse includes defeat, captivity, famine, and exposure to enemies and wild animals.
rows.anchor: وتكون جيفكم مأكلا لجميع السباع وطيور السماء ولا يذب أحد عنكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Torah's curse passage describes Israel as oppressed, exiled, and stripped of security and prosperity.
rows.anchor: عريان فقير , قد أعوزك كل شيء يحتاج إليه , وتخدم أعداءك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Torah explicitly threatens exile from the land Israel was to inherit.
rows.anchor: وتجلون عن الأرض التي تدخلونها لترثوها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Torah says their later generations will abandon the covenant for other gods and suffer divine anger and calamity.
rows.anchor: فيضل ويتبع آلهة أخرى آلهة الشعوب التي تدخل وترى وتسكن بينها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: To the objection that post-Mosaic Israel did not break the covenant, the author answers that their own scripture testifies against them.
rows.anchor: قيل : قد شهد عليكم بذلك ما بين أيديكم من كتابكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The quoted prophecy says God already knew their inclinations before bringing them into the promised land.
rows.anchor: لأني عالم بأهوائهم , وكل ما يصنعونه ها هنا اليوم قبل أن أدخلهم الأرض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The song of Moses says Israel provoked God with foreign idols and sacrifices to demons instead of honoring Him.
rows.anchor: أسخطوني مع الغرباء بأوثانهم وأغضبوني حين ذبحوا للشياطين ولم يقربوا لإله الآلهة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author cites the Torah as evidence that idol worship obligates curse and anger, and says this came to pass after Moses and Joshua.
rows.anchor: هذا ما أردت ذكره من التوراة في الهشادة على لزوم اللعن والغضب لهم بعبادتهم الطواغيت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He points readers to his earlier discussion of the related passage in the Qur'an's account of revelation to the prophets.
rows.anchor: إنا إليك كما أوحينا إلى نوح والنبيين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He links Israel's calf worship and later idolatry to his earlier discussion of Qur'an 2:93.
rows.anchor: وأشربوا في قلوبهم العجل بكفرهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author introduces Joshua's book as further proof that Israel knew God's promises and the curses for violating the covenant.
rows.anchor: ذكر ما يصدق ذلك من سفر يوشع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Joshua reminds Israel that God defeated the nations before them and assigned them the remaining land as their inheritance.
rows.anchor: قد رأيتم ما صنع الله بهذه الشعوب , إنه أهلكهم من بين أديكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Joshua urges them to keep all that Moses recorded and promises God's continued aid against their enemies.
rows.anchor: تقووا جدا واعلموا بجميع ما كتب في سيفر موسى عند الرب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Joshua warns that intermingling and intermarrying with the remaining nations will become snares and lead Israel to destruction.
rows.anchor: إن أنتم خالطتم الشعوب الذين بقوا بينكم وصرتم لهم أختانا صاروا لكم فخاخا وعثرات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Joshua says every good promise was fulfilled, and likewise the curses will fall if Israel breaks God's covenant and commands.
rows.anchor: وكما تم كل الكلام الصالح الذي وعدكم الله به كذلك ينزل بكم كل اللعن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Joshua recounts God's care from Abraham through the Exodus and conquest, including that God turned Balaam's intended curse into blessing.
rows.anchor: ولم يسرني أن أسمع قول بلغام , ولكن باركت عليكم وتجيتكم من يديه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Joshua calls Israel to fear and serve God with integrity, reject their ancestors' idols, and choose whom they will serve.
rows.anchor: فاتقوا الرب واعبدوه بالبر والعدل , واصرفوا عن قلوبكم الفكر في عبادة الآلهة الأخرى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Israel says it will serve God alone because He rescued them from Egypt, performed signs, protected them, and overcame their enemies.
rows.anchor: لأن الله ربنا هو الذي أخرجنا من أرض مصر وخلصنا من العبودية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Joshua warns that serving foreign gods after God's favor will bring anger, calamity, and destruction; the people again deny they will do so.
rows.anchor: فيغضب الرب عليكم وينزل بكم البلاء ويهلككم من بعد إنعامه عليكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author says Israel's first failure was not expelling the pagans but mixing with them during Joshua's lifetime.
rows.anchor: فأول ما دخل عليهم الدخلي أنهم لم يستأصلوا الكفرة وخالطوهم في أيام يوشع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A messenger rebukes Israel for breaking God's covenant by making treaties instead of destroying pagan altars; God will leave those nations as snares.
rows.anchor: وأمرتكم أن لا تعاهدوا أهل هذه الأرض , ولكن استأصلوا مذابحهم , ولم تقبلوا ولم تطيعوني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people weep and offer sacrifices after the messenger's rebuke, but Joshua dies at the age of 120.
rows.anchor: رفع القوم أصواتهم بالبكاء ودعوا اسم ذلك الموضع تحناد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A later generation does not know God or His deeds and worships Baal and Ashtoreth, provoking divine anger and enemy oppression.
rows.anchor: ونشأ من بعدهم حقب لم يعرف الرب ولم يعرف أعماله التي عملها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God periodically raises judges to rescue Israel, but the people return to corruption and idol worship when the judges die.
rows.anchor: فلما توفيت قضاتهم رجعوا إلى الفساد كآبائهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Israel's obedience lasted only until they forgot the pain of punishment and tasted the pleasure of divine favor.
rows.anchor: ولا يستقيمون إلا بقدر ما ينسون حرارة النقم ويذوقون لذاذة النعم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author omits further examples from their books only to avoid tedious length, saying they cannot deny the shameful evidence.
rows.anchor: لا يقدرون على إنكار ما يلزمهم بها من الفضيحة والعار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After announcing the trial, God states the prohibition that had been signaled by warning against approaching the tested object.
rows.anchor: ولما أخبرهم بالابتلاء صرح لهم بما لوح إليه بذكر المخافة من تحريم التعرض لما ابتلاهم به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The address O believers highlights the faith that should prevent transgression.
rows.anchor: فقال منوها بالوصف الناهي عن الاعتداء : { يا أيها الذين آمنوا }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The broader verb kill includes capturing game by any means, since its flight makes slaughter difficult.
rows.anchor: وذكر القتل الذي هو أعم من الذبح إشارة إلى أن الصيد - لما عنده من النفرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Here game means edible wild animals; nonedible animals may be killed because doing so protects people from harm.
rows.anchor: لا تصطادوا ما يحل أكله من الوحش , وأما غير المأكول فيحل قتله

rows.speaker: رسول الله
rows.claim: The Prophet says five harmful creatures may be killed in or out of the sacred state, including the predatory beast.
rows.anchor: خمس في الدواب فواسق , لا جناح على من قتلها في حل ولا حرم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The exemption for harmful animals is grounded in their harm, since permission to kill follows their description as transgressing pests.
rows.anchor: فدل الحكم برفع الجناح عقب الوصف بالفسق على أنه علة الإباحة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The word ḥurum can mean deprived or located within the sanctuary.
rows.anchor: وأنتم حرم } أي محرومون أو في الحرم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Knowing that some will obey and others will disobey from desire, God legislates expiation to ease this community and lift earlier burdens.
rows.anchor: شرع لمن خالف كفارة تخفيفا منه على هذه الأمة ورفعا لما كان على من كان من قبلها من الآصار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Intentional killing means deliberately hunting while remembering one's consecration or the sanctuary and knowing the prohibition.
rows.anchor: قاصدا للصيد ذاكرا للإحرام إن كان محرما , والحرم إن كان فيه عالما بالتحريم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A deliberate violation incurs both sin and compensation; if any element of intent or awareness is absent, the act is error requiring compensation alone.
rows.anchor: هذا الفعل العمد موجبا للإثم والجزاء , ومتى اختل وصف منه كان خطأ موجبا للجزاء فقط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God had already forgiven the Companions' deliberate acts that occasioned the verse, so the wording stipulates compensation without restating their sin.
rows.anchor: قد عفا عن الصحابة رضي الله عنهم العمد الذي كان سببا لنزول الآية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The required match is the closest animal in physical appearance, not species, and compensation comes from livestock.
rows.anchor: أقرب الأشياء به شبها في الصورة لا النوع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On the majority reading, جزاء is annexed to مثل, with the hunted animal as the source's subject in the construction.
rows.anchor: هذا على قراءة الجماعة بإضافة ( جزاء ) إلى ( مثل )

rows.speaker: كوفيون ويعقوب
rows.claim: The Kufan readers and Yaqub give جزاء tanwīn and read مثل in the nominative, making the syntax straightforward.
rows.anchor: وأما على قراءة الكوفيين ويعقوب بتنوين ( جزاء ) ورفع ( مثل )
